items.headline: Texas rises to No. 1 in AP Top 25; Ohio State, Oregon tumble
items.description: The unprecedented comeback by Texas to knock off Ohio State moved the Longhorns to No. 1 in the AP Top 25 and pushed the Buckeyes out of the top five for the first time in two seasons.

items.headline: Kienholz leads as No. 24 Louisville routs Villanova 59-13 for first victory
items.description: — Lincoln Kienholz threw for 332 yards and two touchdowns and ran for two more scores to help No. 24 Louisville beat Villanova 59-13 on Friday night for its first victory of the season.
